notes: VAT standard 20% (Tax Code art. 122(3)). Bullion EXEMPT via the banking channel: art. 118(1.17.5) exempts sales of bank/measured ingots and bullion coins of precious metals (organisations to banks, between banks, banks to organisations and individuals). It covers silver ingots/coins too - silver bullion coded 0; other bullion forms sit outside the quoted exemption. Duty null.

sources.name: Tax Code of the Republic of Belarus, Special Part (pravo.by National Legal Internet Portal), arts. 122 and 118
